snippet.title: Elta: Defy All Gods - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Elta: Defy All Gods’ free demo is out on PC, XBOX and PS5! 
https://tinyurl.com/5ewd43hz

It’s time to get your dragon-god companion back. 🐲
Explore the icy world of Lerna, get a taste of smooth traversal and brawl your way to the first boss of the game. 👊

Play now and join the discord of the game: https://discord.gg/N5jeU5tHeN
